name: Khulan
body:
KHULAN
CR 7

XP 3,200
LN Medium fey (fire, incorporeal)
Init +9; Senses blindsense 60 ft., detect radiation, low-light vision; Perception +23

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 20, flat-footed 14 (+5 Dex, +1 dodge, +4 deflection)
hp 78 (12d6+24+12)
Fort +6, Ref +13, Will +12
Defensive Abilities geomagnetic field, incorporeal; Immune fire, radiation; SR 18; Weakness vulnerable to cold

OFFENSE

Speed fly 40 ft. (perfect)
Melee 2 claws +12 (2d6 B&S) or leeching touch +12 touch (3d6 cold)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 7th, concentration +11)

Constant—detect radiation
1/day—fireball (DC 17), greater teleport

STATISTICS

Str —; Dex 20 (+5); Con 14 (+2); Int 14 (+2); Wis 15 (+2); Cha 18 (+4)
Base Atk +6; CMB +11; CMD 26
Feats Dodge, Improved Initiative, Improved Iron Will, Iron Will, Skill Focus (Perception), Toughness
Skills Fly +13, Intimidate +16, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +18, Knowledge (geography, nature) +17, Perception +23, Sense Motive +17, Stealth +20, Survival +14; Species Modifiers +4 Knowledge (dungeoneering)
Languages Common, Ignan, Terran, Undercommon

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Geomagnetic Field (Su)

As a move action while on a planet that has at least a thin atmosphere and a mass at least 1/50th that of Earth, a khulan can generate a 10-foot-radius protective field that grants resistance to cold, electricity, and fire damage within the protected area. If the planet’s atmosphere is thin, this resistance value is 5, and the resistance increases to 7 or 10 if the atmosphere is normal or thick, respectively. A khulan’s attacks ignore any energy resistance granted by a khulan’s geomagnetic field ability. The barrier also grants all creatures in its area a +4 circumstance bonus to saves against radiation.

The barrier’s area of effect is centered on and moves with the khulan, and the field persists until the khulan is incapacitated or it dismisses the field; this doesn’t require an action.

Leeching Touch (Su)

As a standard action, a khulan can make a touch attack with their incorporeal limbs. On a hit against a living creature, this attack deals 3d6 cold damage, and the khulan regains a number of hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

ECOLOGY

Environment any land or underground
Organization solitary, pair, or patrol (3–9)
Treasure incidental

Khulans are the fey keepers of planet cores.

They usually dwell deep beneath the surface, where they slip silently between the layers of a world that few others ever see: past the fossil record, undiscovered biomes, deepest crust, and molten mantle, all the way to the metallic core Some khulans dwell on older planets or protoplanets that have cooled or lost their magnetospheres, and they have seemed to age and fade—becoming increasingly pale, ghostly, and detached from the Material Realm. However, the best known khulans are from planets with plenty of habitable potential remaining in them. There, the khulans work tirelessly to protect the electromagnetic and geothermal balance of their adopted homes.

Occasionally, these objectives put a khulan into conflict with surface dwellers—or dwellers of subterranean settlements—who threaten the environment. However, more often than many fey, khulans may determine that these settlers need protection from environmental pressures caused by massive geothermal upheavals. In fact, given the enormity of the scope and scale of such events, a khulan may feel the need to enlist the help of intelligent settlers to protect the planet if they have the magical or technological means to do so.
